# Requirements analysis skill: Expense Tracker

Use this skill when defining or changing the local Expense Tracker contract. Inspect the current source and tests, then capture add/list/total/filter behavior, supported categories, Decimal precision, JSON persistence, validation, failure safety, acceptance criteria, and out-of-scope features in `docs/requirements-analysis.md`. Every criterion must be observable through a test or CLI behavior. Do not turn existing implementation details into requirements without human approval.
